def solve_lukas_problem():
    n = int(input())
    ring = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]
    
    original_ring = [0] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        prev = ring[i-1]
        curr = ring[i]
        next = ring[(i+1) % n]
        
        original_ring[i] = max(0, curr - prev - next)
    
    for num in original_ring:
        print(num)
